companies.title: Teams that hire with us
companies.subtitle: From startups to established institutions — you've seen us here.

problem.title: Hiring is slow, messy, and unfair to everyone.
problem.subtitle: Every extra week of screening costs you great candidates — and every inconsistent interview hides the truth.

items.title: Screening eats your week
items.body: Hundreds of applications and endless email chains just to fill a single slot.

items.title: Every interview is different
items.body: Unstructured conversations make candidates impossible to compare fairly.

items.title: Candidates hear nothing back
items.body: Weeks of silence after applying — and your employer brand pays for it.

items.title: Scheduling ping-pong
items.body: Booking one call takes days of back-and-forth messages.

items.quote: I used to freeze in interviews. After four practice sessions with Zuri I knew exactly how to structure my answers — two of my top three companies shortlisted me that same month.
items.name: Amina Yusuf

items.quote: The AI interviewer felt like a real conversation, not a form. The report showed me exactly which skills I hadn't covered — and the next interview, I nailed it.
items.name: David Kimani

items.quote: We used to spend our evenings on first-round calls. Now candidates self-book, Zuri runs the first round, and we only meet the shortlist.
items.name: Grace Mwangi

items.quote: I applied from my phone in Swahili during a lunch break. No camera, no special setup — and I still got a fair, structured shot at the role.
items.name: Samuel Otieno

items.quote: Same questions, same rubric for every candidate — our shortlist finally rests on evidence we can defend to any panel.
items.name: Lydia Hassan
items.result: Bias out of the first cut

items.quote: I prepared on my commute, interviewed after work, and had my first offer letter the same week the report went out.
items.name: Brian Wekesa

items.quote: Practicing in Swahili made all the difference. The questions felt like my own words, not a translation I had to survive.
items.name: Fatuma Ali

items.quote: Every shortlist now comes with transcripts and scores. Debates in our debriefs end in minutes, not days.
items.name: Peter Njoroge

items.quote: Candidates used to go quiet after our interviews. Now they get a real report, and even the rejected ones thank us.
items.name: Halima Rashid

items.quote: Six applications, six silences. Then three structured interviews on Zuri — and two offers to choose from.
items.name: Daniel Mwakalinga

features.title: Everything here exists to get great people hired faster.
features.subtitle: Benefits first, features second — with evidence you can trust behind every decision.

items.title: Hire with confidence, not gut feel
items.body: Every answer is scored against a published rubric, so decisions rest on evidence.

items.title: Shortlists in hours, not weeks
items.body: Candidates self-book from your availability and are matched to the role automatically.

items.title: Feedback candidates actually receive
items.body: A structured report follows every session — no more silence after applying.

items.title: The same fair shot for everyone
items.body: Identical questions and scoring rules remove bias from the first cut.

items.title: Works where your candidates are
items.body: Phone or laptop, Swahili or English, camera optional — no special setup.

items.title: Reports you can defend
items.body: A transparent scoring basis with full transcripts — no black-box judgments.

howItWorks.title: Three steps. That's the whole process.
howItWorks.subtitle: From posting the role to a confident decision — without the busywork in between.

steps.title: Set the role
steps.body: Interviewers post the role with required skills; candidates complete a verified profile.

steps.title: The AI interviews
steps.body: Zuri runs a structured session, question by question, in Swahili or English.

steps.title: Decide with evidence
steps.body: Scores, transcript, and a clear report land the moment the session ends.

objections.title: Questions, answered honestly.
objections.subtitle: Everything teams and candidates ask before their first session.

items.answer: Every candidate gets the same questions, scored against a rubric that's visible before the session starts. The AI never makes the final call — your team reviews the evidence and decides.

items.concern: Do I need a special setup?
items.answer: No. A phone or laptop with a browser is enough. Camera is optional, and you can type or speak your answers.
Nothing right now. The platform is free during the beta — no credit card and no trial countdown.
Only the hiring team behind the role you applied to. Transcripts and reports aren't shared with anyone else.
